Details

Five weeks of real games with the same group. Every Tuesday from 11:00 to 1:00 in Lucky Sevens, starting November 10. Scores are kept each week and your lowest week is dropped, so you can miss one without hurting your standing.

The top three win prizes on the final night: a Mahjong Co. tile set for first, an Oh My Mahjong bag for second, and an Oh My Mahjong tile bag for third.

For players who have finished Mahj 103 or already play a full game. Bring your 2026 card.

One price covers the season. No refunds after the first session. A missed week becomes your dropped week.

Instructions

We play in Lucky Sevens at Lucky Hare, 8687 W. Sahara Ave, Suite 200. Please arrive by 10:50 so we can start right at 11:00.

Bring your 2026 card. Tiles, racks and tables are all set up for you.

Can't make a week? Please find a sub to take your seat and text me their name so I know who's coming. Your sub needs to know how to play a full game, and they play for free. Their score doesn't count for you, so a missed week becomes your dropped week.
